append.detail: Premise re-tested after ADR-1439: a Hub and a Nexus are now a Space (hubs.space_id, nexuses.space_id; /hubs and /nexuses 308 to /spaces), so a Hub-wide gathering is an event placed on that Space through the existing request and approval, with the Space visibility gates, and the Space page lists it (SpaceEvents, listEventsForSpace). The gap was who leads it: nothing made the Guide (hubs.guide_id) or Mentor (nexuses.mentor_id) a steward of that Space, so a request reached only staff. Now listPlaceLeadIds adds them to the placement approvers and the event creators, viewerIsSteward admits them, the Hosted by picker offers their Hub or Nexus Space, and the Leadership page shows each led Space's pending requests under Your networks. Events only: no other Space capability. No migration.
